lines.text: After crossing the Jordan, Israel is to set up plastered stones on Mount Ebal and write the law on them.
Israel is to build an altar of uncut stones, offer burnt offerings, and eat grain offerings, rejoicing before the LORD.
Moses and the Levitical priests tell Israel to be silent and listen, because they have become the LORD's people.
Six tribes stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, and six stand on Mount Ebal to deliver the curse.
The elders proclaim in a loud voice a curse on anyone who sets up a carved idol in secret.
